title: Planeó una masacre escolar con ChatGPT, intervino el FBI y no recibirá ninguna pena

reading.body:
A teenager used ChatGPT to plan a school shooting and discuss killing classmates. The AI system did not refuse these requests or flag the activity to its operators. The planning took place on a commercial platform deployed without the capability to detect or report such uses to law enforcement, meaning detection depended entirely on external intelligence work.

The FBI's legal attaché in Buenos Aires discovered the activity through means not established in the reporting and alerted Argentine authorities, leading to investigation and a police raid. This shows that even when an AI system is used to plan violence, the system itself provides no automatic detection mechanism. Catching such activity required human intelligence work operating outside the platform, not safeguards within it.

It is not established whether ChatGPT's terms of service were violated, what technical or policy measures the company had in place, or whether the teenager's account showed any flags to the platform's moderation systems.

reports.title: Un adolescente planificó con la Inteligencia Artificial matar a sus compañeros de colegio: fue detectado por el FBI y allanado en Quilmes
Cómo descubrió el FBI al chico de 15 años que organizaba con IA una masacre escolar en Quilmes y cuál era su plan
Un adolescente planificó con Inteligencia Artificial matar a sus compañeros: el FBI dio aviso y lo allanaron en Quilmes
Planeó una masacre escolar con ChatGPT, intervino el FBI y no recibirá ninguna pena

summary:
A 15-year-old teenager in Quilmes was investigated after the FBI's legal attaché at the U.S. Embassy in Buenos Aires alerted Argentine authorities about concerning online activity. The teen had used the artificial intelligence platform ChatGPT to plan a shooting at a school and discuss killing classmates, with the attack initially planned for 2027 though possibly sooner. The investigation began on August 19th after receiving this intelligence tip.

Federal Police detectives conducted a raid on the teenager's home and seized two cell phones, tactical gloves, military camouflage clothing, balaclavas, and tactical glasses. A juvenile court judge ordered the operation, and the teen and his parents were summoned to the juvenile prosecutor's office in Quilmes. Judge Miriam Alcolcel is overseeing the case, which is being investigated under public intimidation charges. The seized items have been placed at the judge's disposal as evidence.
title_en: He planned a school massacre with ChatGPT, the FBI intervened and he will receive no punishment
